title: Correct C_v Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate C_v as c.

title: Correct C_p Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive C_p using the appropriate equations and substitutions.

title: Use of Van der Waals Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Van der Waals equation in their derivation of C_p.

title: Partial Derivatives
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly compute the necessary partial derivatives for the heat capacities.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the chain rule.

title: Final Answer Presentation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present final answers clearly and in a readable format.
